jobs.title: Head of Engineering, ML, Forma Generative AI
jobs.description:
Job Requisition ID #

26WD101528

Position Overview

Autodesk is transforming how the AEC industry designs and builds through integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) across its products, including AutoCAD, Revit, and Forma.

As Head of Engineering, ML for Forma Generative AI, you will lead the ML Engineering organization responsible for computational design and data representations, applied ML model development, and ML infrastructure and operations. You will lead through three engineering managers, setting the ML strategy for the team, defining the technical and organizational standards across the discipline, and shaping how teams build, deploy, and operate production ML systems.

You will partner closely with Architecture, Software Engineering, Research, Product, and other senior leaders to define technical direction, resolve cross-organizational trade-offs, and ensure the organization can move from promising ML research to reliable product capabilities at scale.

Report:
You will report to the Director, Forma Generative AI.

Location:
We support hybrid work, and you work near our Toronto, Canada office. This role requires the ability to travel to team meetings, offsites, and conferences in the USA, Canada, and Europe.

Responsibilities

Define and uphold ML engineering strategy, standards, and expectations across the organization, including how ML systems are designed, tested, reviewed, deployed, evaluated, and operated in production
Lead and develop the engineering managers responsible for Computational Design & Data Representations, Applied ML, and ML Infrastructure and Operations. Own the evolution of the ML engineering organization, including team structure, boundaries, hiring, succession, and organizational design
Partner with Architecture and peer engineering leaders to establish shared ML architectures, reusable components, and engineering practices that enable teams to move quickly without compromising quality or consistency
Partner with Research, Product, and Engineering leaders to balance long-term ML research and platform investments with iterative product delivery; align priorities, staffing, and capacity across the ML organization; surface constraints early and resolve cross-team trade-offs to keep critical work moving
Represent ML engineering in organizational planning, resourcing, escalations, and major technical decisions, serving as the discipline’s leadership voice across Forma Generative AI
Build a high-trust engineering culture that develops strong technical leaders, encourages knowledge sharing, and raises the quality of engineering judgement across the organization

Minimum Qualifications

BS or MS in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field, or equivalent experience
8+ years of software/ML engineering experience, including 4+ years of engineering management experience and demonstrated experience managing engineering managers or leading multiple engineering teams
Track record building and operating production ML systems at scale across training, deployment, inference, monitoring, and evaluation
Experience establishing engineering standards and technical direction across multiple teams without centralizing every decision
Demonstrated success hiring, developing, and retaining engineering managers and senior technical leads, with strong communication and influence across senior stakeholders

Preferred Qualifications

Experience leading engineering organizations responsible for large-scale ML or foundation-model systems
Deep technical familiarity with modern ML engineering and production infrastructure, including ML frameworks (e.g. PyTorch), distributed training and inference, cloud infrastructure, observability, CI/CD, Infrastructure-as-Code, and production automation
Experience designing or leading development of foundation-model and agentic systems, including evaluation harnesses, tool-use/orchestration patterns, and other production scaffolding around models
Experience partnering with peer engineering, architecture, research, and product leaders in a matrixed organization
Experience in the AEC industry, Autodesk products, or another technically complex design/engineering domain
Experience applying rapidly evolving foundation-model and agentic-system technologies in production environments

The Ideal Candidate

You know the difference between managing a team and leading an organization; you develop strong managers, create clear ownership, and scale through others
You can establish a technical bar and make it stick through standards, coaching, and strong engineering judgement rather than personal gatekeeping
You build trust with senior peers across architecture, research, product, and engineering, and can navigate disagreement and ambiguity while keeping the organization moving
You communicate effectively across disciplines and levels, adapting your approach to build shared understanding with technical, product, research, and executive audiences

Learn More / En savoir plus

About Autodesk

Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.

We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world.

When you’re an Autodesker, you can do meaningful work that helps build a better world designed and made for all. Ready to shape the world and your future? Join us!

À propos d’Autodesk

Bienvenue chez Autodesk ! Nos logiciels créent chaque jour des choses extraordinaires : des bâtiments les plus écologiques aux voitures les plus propres, en passant par les usines les plus intelligentes et les films à succès. Nous aidons les innovateurs à concrétiser leurs idées, transformant non seulement la façon dont les choses sont fabriquées, mais aussi ce qui peut l’être.

Nous sommes très fiers de notre culture chez Autodesk ; elle est au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons. Notre culture guide notre façon de travailler et de nous comporter les uns envers les autres, influence nos interactions avec nos clients et nos partenaires, et définit notre image au monde.

En tant qu’Autodeskien, vous pouvez accomplir un travail significatif qui contribue à bâtir un monde meilleur, conçu et réalisé pour tous. Prêt à façonner le monde et votre avenir ? Rejoignez-nous !

Salary transparency /
Transparence Salariale

Salary is one part of Autodesk’s competitive compensation package. For Canada based roles, we expect a starting base salary between $183,000 and $268,400 Annual. Offers are based on the candidate’s experience and geographic location, and may exceed this range. In addition to base salaries, our compensation package may include annual cash bonuses, commissions for sales roles, stock grants, and a comprehensive benefits package. Le salaire est déterminé selon l'expérience professionnelle et l'emplacement du candidat(e), et peut dépasser cette fourchette. En plus du salaire de base, notre programme de rémunération peut inclure une prime annuelle, des commissions pour les postes de ventes, des attributions d'actions et un ensemble complet d'avantages sociaux.

jobs.title: Director, Finance Business Partnering, GTS
jobs.description:
Venture outside the ordinary - TMX Careers

The TMX group of companies includes leading global exchanges such as the Toronto Stock Exchange, Montreal Exchange, and numerous innovative organizations enhancing capital markets. United as a global team, we’re connecting cross-functionally, traversing industries and geographies, moving opportunity into action, advancing global economic growth, and propelling progress. Through a rich exchange of ideas, meaningful collaboration, and a nimble operating model, we're powering some of the nation's most critical systems, fueling capital formation and innovation, bringing increased opportunity to business visionaries, product ingenuity to consumers, and career exploration to our team.

Ready to be part of the action?

Working in Finance as a Finance Business Partnering leader, this role is the primary finance business partner for GTS, the technology engine behind TMX’s growth strategy and business units.

FBPs empower financially sound planning and decision making throughout the organization. You will do this by spreading financial acumen; telling compelling, data-driven stories to spur action; bridging the knowledge gap between finance and operations; and assisting in the creation of financial planning and analysis’s (FP&A’s) decision support tools. As an FBP, you will simplify FP&A analysis into easily digestible business logic and take a more technology-guided and teaching-focused approach to business partnering, enabling decision makers to make sound financial decisions more independently. The C-suite and business unit executives will also rely on you as a sought-after thought-partner for strategic decisions and for insights that help achieve performance targets and outcomes.

This role has one direct report and a total team size of 2.

Responsibilities:

Strategic Finance Business Partnering: Global Technology Services (GTS)
Serve as a trusted strategic advisor to the CIO and GTS Leadership Team, providing financial leadership, strategic guidance, and commercial governance across all technology spend
Drive cloud financial management (FinOps), developing models to monitor, forecast, and optimize variable cloud infrastructure (AWS/Azure/GCP), SaaS licensing, and emerging GenAI consumption costs
Provide rigorous business case development and ROI tracking for major technology investments, cyber-security initiatives, enterprise platform upgrades, and infrastructure refresh cycles
Oversee technology capitalization governance (IAS 38 / IFRS), optimizing the financial treatment of internally developed software, R&D, and capital project portfolios
Accountable for the consolidated planning (Budgets, Multi-Year Strategic Plans, and Rolling Forecasts) for the GTS organization
Partner with Central Corporate FP&A to shape the technology cost allocation framework (Shared Services / CAM), helping GTS defend technology charges and articulate unit-cost value to Business Unit leaders
Lead vendor spend analytics and commercial evaluations for major technology, hardware, and software software contract negotiations[cite: 1].
Ensure pristine financial integrity, accounting rigor, and month-end/quarter-end reporting accuracy for all GTS operational and capital ledgers
Support deeper understanding of GTS technology cost base, supporting the fast changing technology landscape and further adoption of cloud and AI services
Provide in-depth, highly personalized decision support to executive decision makers: initiative modeling/tracking and business case development, continuously and proactively guiding executives to meet and surpass performance goals, and monitoring of leading indicators
Deepen nonexecutive decision makers’ FP&A acumen to enable independent decision making
Member of GTS senior leadership team and key adviser to the CIO
Other
Collaborate with PMO and Corporate FP&A teams on enterprise portfolio governance
Partner with Corporate FP&A, Corporate Strategy and Strategic Finance teams on advancing enterprise analysis and insights generation
Partner with Corporate Controller to migrate appropriate portions of accounting work to the central accounting team
Champion and participate in knowledge-sharing forums for FBPs and FP&A to exchange lessons learned on how to best educate decision makers in FP&A’s thought processes during decision support

Must have experience and skills:

10+ years of dedicated Technology Finance / FinOps / IT Business Partnering experience within a complex corporate or capital markets environment
Strong understanding of software capitalization rules (IFRS/IAS 38), cloud cost economics (OpEx vs. CapEx models), and technology vendor contract structures
Proven track record of influencing C-suite technology executives (CIO/CTO) through data-driven financial storytelling
CPA designation
Strong organizational, analytical and conceptual skills, able to work at a high level and in detail
Able to work effectively across organizational lines and promotes an effective team-based environment with employees and management at all levels of the organization
Effective and positive management style supporting staff through example, coaching and development
Strong technical skills, including spreadsheets (pivot tables, model building, model auditing) and knowledge of financial systems structure
GenAI work augmentation
Data visualization and data storytelling
Strong financial analysis skills, ability to undertake research
Results oriented and the ability to work under tight deadlines, and manage competing priorities
Customer service orientation
Leverage excellent verbal and written communication skills by tailoring messages according to audience
Ability to effectively prioritize work and manage large volume of change in an ambiguous, complex environment
Strong problem-solving and critical thinking skills
Relationship builder and collaborator
Excellent ability to influence with a collaborative nature and strong communication/interpersonal skills, both written and oral
Strong team player and self-starter

Nice-to-have experience and skills:

FinOps Certified Practitioner (FCP) or Technology Business Management (TBM) framework exposure
Software / technology or capital markets
CFA designation or MBA
Workday Financials / Adaptive Planning / HCM
Google Suite of Tools for Work (Sheets, Docs, Slides)

This role is hybrid (3-5 days/week in the office) - based in Toronto, ON.

Salary Range: $160,000/year -$180,000/year CAD

Please note that the salary range included is a guideline only. The salary offered may vary based on factors, including, but not limited to, the successful candidate’s relevant knowledge, skills, and experience.

In the market for…

Excitement
- Explore emerging technology and innovation, as well as ventures and digital finance that shape the future of global markets! Experience the movement of the market while grounded in the stability of close to 200 years of success.

Connection
- With site hubs in some of the world’s most multicultural cities, we leverage our size and structure to create rich connections and belonging while experiencing powerful global impact through our work.

Impact
- More than a platform, we use our talents to power mission-critical systems that drive global economic advancement, innovation, and growth. As well, our employee-led Team Impact spreads social good via our giving strategy.

Wellness
- From empathetic leadership to a culture of flexibility and balance, we believe wellness at work creates the maximum yield and a stronger “we”. Plus, with a cloud-first and hybrid workstyle, as well as generous time-off and leaves, we support a life well lived!

Growth
- From a growth mindset in our work, to expansion in our business, TMX is home to action-takers energized by the achievement of ambitious growth.

Ready to enrich your career with impactful work, leaders who truly care, and the flexibility and programs to help you thrive as part of #TeamTMX ? Apply now.

Please note that our company is not currently sponsoring work permit applications and the applicant must be authorized to work in the country where this position is located.

TMX is committed to creating and sustaining a collegial work environment in which all individuals are treated with dignity and respect and one which reflects the diversity of the community in which we operate. We provide accommodations for applicants and employees who require it .

jobs.title: Senior Director, Data Center Facilities Development
jobs.description:
Job Description

The Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Data Center Development organization leads the planning, design, and delivery of the next generation of Oracle’s global data center portfolio. We are seeking a Senior Director of Data Center Development to provide strategic leadership and organizational oversight for the design of mission-critical infrastructure across OCI’s rapidly expanding global footprint.

This role is responsible for establishing and executing OCI’s data center design strategy across a portfolio of large-scale, highly complex developments. The Senior Director will lead a team of design management professionals and provide executive-level oversight of multidisciplinary design activities spanning architectural, structural, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, controls, and mission-critical infrastructure systems.

The position requires a combination of organizational leadership, technical depth, design governance, and portfolio management. The successful candidate will establish clear design requirements, drive consistency across projects and delivery partners, manage technical risk, and ensure that OCI’s facilities meet established requirements for performance, reliability, resiliency, scalability, constructability, and operational readiness.

The Senior Director will serve as a senior technical and organizational leader within OCI Data Center Development, partnering closely with Construction, Engineering, Operations, Network, Capacity Planning, Energy, Security, and other internal organizations. The role will also provide senior-level direction to colocation partners, architects, engineers, consultants, contractors, and other external stakeholders responsible for delivering OCI

Responsibilities

Responsibilities:

Lead the Data Center Design Management function for an assigned global or multi-region portfolio of hyperscale and mission-critical infrastructure projects.
Establish organizational priorities, expectations, governance processes, and performance standards for the design management team.
Lead, develop, and mentor design managers and design leadership personnel, establishing clear accountability for project execution, technical quality, and professional development.
Provide portfolio-level oversight of multidisciplinary data center design across architectural, structural, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, controls, life safety, and supporting infrastructure systems.
Establish and maintain design governance throughout the project lifecycle, from early planning and Basis of Design development through schematic design, design development, construction documentation, construction support, commissioning, and record documentation.
Ensure projects maintain alignment with OCI technical requirements, design standards, operational requirements, reliability objectives, and infrastructure strategies.
Provide senior technical leadership for high-density compute environments, including mechanical systems, liquid cooling, electrical infrastructure, controls, and other mission-critical systems supporting next-generation cloud and AI infrastructure.
Drive consistent implementation and continuous improvement of OCI global data center design standards, specifications, design criteria, and best practices.
Establish effective design review, technical approval, change management, and decision-making processes across the portfolio.
Identify systemic and project-specific design risks and ensure appropriate mitigation, escalation, and resolution before those risks impact construction, schedule, cost, reliability, or operations.
Lead resolution of complex multidisciplinary technical issues requiring coordination across internal organizations, design consultants, construction teams, operators, and external delivery partners.
Partner with Construction, Engineering, Operations, Network, Capacity Planning, Energy, Security, and other OCI organizations to ensure infrastructure requirements are coordinated and incorporated into project designs.
Provide senior-level oversight of architects, engineers, consultants, colocation providers, and other design partners responsible for delivering OCI infrastructure.
Establish expectations for consultant scope, performance, technical quality, schedule adherence, and design deliverables.
Ensure Basis of Design, SD, DD, permit, IFC, and record design packages meet OCI requirements and are appropriately reviewed and approved.
Drive standardization and repeatability while maintaining the flexibility necessary to address regional requirements, site conditions, utility constraints, code requirements, and evolving technology.
Evaluate proposed design changes and deviations to determine portfolio-level impacts to reliability, operations, schedule, cost, standards, and future scalability.
Develop and monitor design performance metrics, portfolio risks, technical issues, and organizational priorities, providing clear reporting and recommendations to executive leadership.
Support strategic planning for future data center capacity, emerging technologies, new infrastructure architectures, and evolving cloud and AI requirements.
Represent OCI Data Center Design Management in executive reviews, technical workshops, partner engagements, design reviews, and other internal and external forums.
Build a culture of technical rigor, accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and disciplined design governance across the organization.

Required Qualifications:

Professional licensure required as a Registered Architect (RA) or Professional Engineer (PE).
Accredited degree in Architecture, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Structural Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
12+ years of progressively responsible experience in data center, mission-critical, industrial, or large-scale infrastructure design and development.
Significant leadership experience managing design professionals, multidisciplinary technical teams, and external architecture and engineering organizations.
Demonstrated experience leading large-scale hyperscale, cloud, colocation, or mission-critical infrastructure programs.
Strong multidisciplinary understanding of data center architectural, structural, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, controls, life safety, and supporting infrastructure systems.
Demonstrated ability to establish and manage design governance, standards, technical requirements, and change control across multiple concurrent projects.
Experience managing complex project portfolios involving multiple sites, delivery partners, consultants, and internal stakeholders.
Strong understanding of data center mechanical and cooling infrastructure, with experience in high-density and liquid-cooled environments strongly preferred.
Strong understanding of data center electrical distribution, resiliency strategies, controls, commissioning, and operational requirements.
Demonstrated ability to identify, communicate, and resolve complex technical and organizational risks.
Experience working within accelerated design and construction programs where schedule, scalability, repeatability, and technical quality are critical.
Strong executive communication, organizational leadership, negotiation, and decision-making skills.
Ability to communicate complex technical issues clearly to both executive and technical audiences.
Working knowledge of applicable data center codes, standards, and industry guidance, including NFPA, ASHRAE, IBC, and other applicable international, national, and local requirements.

Preferred Qualifications:

15+ years of experience in mission-critical or large-scale infrastructure design and development.
Experience leading design organizations supporting hyperscale cloud or AI infrastructure.
Experience managing global or multi-region data center portfolios.
Experience developing and implementing enterprise-level data center design standards, specifications, and governance programs.
Experience with high-density compute environments, direct-to-chip liquid cooling, advanced thermal management, and next-generation data center infrastructure.
Experience with colocation and developer-led delivery models, including oversight of third-party design and construction partners.
Experience implementing formal design review, technical deviation, change management, and lessons-learned processes.
Working knowledge of BIM, digital design coordination, document management, and design collaboration platforms.
LEED AP, Uptime ATD, or other relevant mission-critical industry certifications.
Demonstrated experience developing high-performing technical teams and future organizational leaders.

Qualifications

Range and benefit information provided in this posting are specific to the stated locations only

True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. Venture outside the ordinary - TMX Careers

The TMX group of companies includes leading global exchanges such as the Toronto Stock Exchange, Montreal Exchange, and numerous innovative organizations enhancing capital markets. United as a global team, we’re connecting cross-functionally, traversing industries and geographies, moving opportunity into action, advancing global economic growth, and propelling progress. Through a rich exchange of ideas, meaningful collaboration, and a nimble operating model, we're powering some of the nation's most critical systems, fueling capital formation and innovation, bringing increased opportunity to business visionaries, product ingenuity to consumers, and career exploration to our team.

Ready to be part of the action?

Working in Finance as a Finance Business Partnering leader, this role is the primary finance business partner for GTS, the technology engine behind TMX’s growth strategy and business units.

FBPs empower financially sound planning and decision making throughout the organization. You will do this by spreading financial acumen; telling compelling, data-driven stories to spur action; bridging the knowledge gap between finance and operations; and assisting in the creation of financial planning and analysis’s (FP&A’s) decision support tools. As an FBP, you will simplify FP&A analysis into easily digestible business logic and take a more technology-guided and teaching-focused approach to business partnering, enabling decision makers to make sound financial decisions more independently. The C-suite and business unit executives will also rely on you as a sought-after thought-partner for strategic decisions and for insights that help achieve performance targets and outcomes.

This role has one direct report and a total team size of 2.

Responsibilities:

Strategic Finance Business Partnering: Global Technology Services (GTS)
Serve as a trusted strategic advisor to the CIO and GTS Leadership Team, providing financial leadership, strategic guidance, and commercial governance across all technology spend
Drive cloud financial management (FinOps), developing models to monitor, forecast, and optimize variable cloud infrastructure (AWS/Azure/GCP), SaaS licensing, and emerging GenAI consumption costs
Provide rigorous business case development and ROI tracking for major technology investments, cyber-security initiatives, enterprise platform upgrades, and infrastructure refresh cycles
Oversee technology capitalization governance (IAS 38 / IFRS), optimizing the financial treatment of internally developed software, R&D, and capital project portfolios
Accountable for the consolidated planning (Budgets, Multi-Year Strategic Plans, and Rolling Forecasts) for the GTS organization
Partner with Central Corporate FP&A to shape the technology cost allocation framework (Shared Services / CAM), helping GTS defend technology charges and articulate unit-cost value to Business Unit leaders
Lead vendor spend analytics and commercial evaluations for major technology, hardware, and software software contract negotiations[cite: 1].
Ensure pristine financial integrity, accounting rigor, and month-end/quarter-end reporting accuracy for all GTS operational and capital ledgers
Support deeper understanding of GTS technology cost base, supporting the fast changing technology landscape and further adoption of cloud and AI services
Provide in-depth, highly personalized decision support to executive decision makers: initiative modeling/tracking and business case development, continuously and proactively guiding executives to meet and surpass performance goals, and monitoring of leading indicators
Deepen nonexecutive decision makers’ FP&A acumen to enable independent decision making
Member of GTS senior leadership team and key adviser to the CIO
Other
Collaborate with PMO and Corporate FP&A teams on enterprise portfolio governance
Partner with Corporate FP&A, Corporate Strategy and Strategic Finance teams on advancing enterprise analysis and insights generation
Partner with Corporate Controller to migrate appropriate portions of accounting work to the central accounting team
Champion and participate in knowledge-sharing forums for FBPs and FP&A to exchange lessons learned on how to best educate decision makers in FP&A’s thought processes during decision support

Must have experience and skills:

10+ years of dedicated Technology Finance / FinOps / IT Business Partnering experience within a complex corporate or capital markets environment
Strong understanding of software capitalization rules (IFRS/IAS 38), cloud cost economics (OpEx vs. CapEx models), and technology vendor contract structures
Proven track record of influencing C-suite technology executives (CIO/CTO) through data-driven financial storytelling
CPA designation
Strong organizational, analytical and conceptual skills, able to work at a high level and in detail
Able to work effectively across organizational lines and promotes an effective team-based environment with employees and management at all levels of the organization
Effective and positive management style supporting staff through example, coaching and development
Strong technical skills, including spreadsheets (pivot tables, model building, model auditing) and knowledge of financial systems structure
GenAI work augmentation
Data visualization and data storytelling
Strong financial analysis skills, ability to undertake research
Results oriented and the ability to work under tight deadlines, and manage competing priorities
Customer service orientation
Leverage excellent verbal and written communication skills by tailoring messages according to audience
Ability to effectively prioritize work and manage large volume of change in an ambiguous, complex environment
Strong problem-solving and critical thinking skills
Relationship builder and collaborator
Excellent ability to influence with a collaborative nature and strong communication/interpersonal skills, both written and oral
Strong team player and self-starter

Nice-to-have experience and skills:

FinOps Certified Practitioner (FCP) or Technology Business Management (TBM) framework exposure
Software / technology or capital markets
CFA designation or MBA
Workday Financials / Adaptive Planning / HCM
Google Suite of Tools for Work (Sheets, Docs, Slides)

This role is hybrid (3-5 days/week in the office) - based in Toronto, ON.

Salary Range: $160,000/year -$180,000/year CAD

Please note that the salary range included is a guideline only. The salary offered may vary based on factors, including, but not limited to, the successful candidate’s relevant knowledge, skills, and experience.

In the market for…

Excitement
- Explore emerging technology and innovation, as well as ventures and digital finance that shape the future of global markets! Experience the movement of the market while grounded in the stability of close to 200 years of success.

Connection
- With site hubs in some of the world’s most multicultural cities, we leverage our size and structure to create rich connections and belonging while experiencing powerful global impact through our work.

Impact
- More than a platform, we use our talents to power mission-critical systems that drive global economic advancement, innovation, and growth. As well, our employee-led Team Impact spreads social good via our giving strategy.

Wellness
- From empathetic leadership to a culture of flexibility and balance, we believe wellness at work creates the maximum yield and a stronger “we”. Plus, with a cloud-first and hybrid workstyle, as well as generous time-off and leaves, we support a life well lived!

Growth
- From a growth mindset in our work, to expansion in our business, TMX is home to action-takers energized by the achievement of ambitious growth.

Ready to enrich your career with impactful work, leaders who truly care, and the flexibility and programs to help you thrive as part of #TeamTMX ? Apply now.

new_jobs.description:
Job Description

The Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Data Center Development organization leads the planning, design, and delivery of the next generation of Oracle’s global data center portfolio. We are seeking a Senior Director of Data Center Development to provide strategic leadership and organizational oversight for the design of mission-critical infrastructure across OCI’s rapidly expanding global footprint.

This role is responsible for establishing and executing OCI’s data center design strategy across a portfolio of large-scale, highly complex developments. The Senior Director will lead a team of design management professionals and provide executive-level oversight of multidisciplinary design activities spanning architectural, structural, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, controls, and mission-critical infrastructure systems.

The position requires a combination of organizational leadership, technical depth, design governance, and portfolio management. The successful candidate will establish clear design requirements, drive consistency across projects and delivery partners, manage technical risk, and ensure that OCI’s facilities meet established requirements for performance, reliability, resiliency, scalability, constructability, and operational readiness.

The Senior Director will serve as a senior technical and organizational leader within OCI Data Center Development, partnering closely with Construction, Engineering, Operations, Network, Capacity Planning, Energy, Security, and other internal organizations. The role will also provide senior-level direction to colocation partners, architects, engineers, consultants, contractors, and other external stakeholders responsible for delivering OCI

Responsibilities

Responsibilities:

Lead the Data Center Design Management function for an assigned global or multi-region portfolio of hyperscale and mission-critical infrastructure projects.
Establish organizational priorities, expectations, governance processes, and performance standards for the design management team.
Lead, develop, and mentor design managers and design leadership personnel, establishing clear accountability for project execution, technical quality, and professional development.
Provide portfolio-level oversight of multidisciplinary data center design across architectural, structural, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, controls, life safety, and supporting infrastructure systems.
Establish and maintain design governance throughout the project lifecycle, from early planning and Basis of Design development through schematic design, design development, construction documentation, construction support, commissioning, and record documentation.
Ensure projects maintain alignment with OCI technical requirements, design standards, operational requirements, reliability objectives, and infrastructure strategies.
Provide senior technical leadership for high-density compute environments, including mechanical systems, liquid cooling, electrical infrastructure, controls, and other mission-critical systems supporting next-generation cloud and AI infrastructure.
Drive consistent implementation and continuous improvement of OCI global data center design standards, specifications, design criteria, and best practices.
Establish effective design review, technical approval, change management, and decision-making processes across the portfolio.
Identify systemic and project-specific design risks and ensure appropriate mitigation, escalation, and resolution before those risks impact construction, schedule, cost, reliability, or operations.
Lead resolution of complex multidisciplinary technical issues requiring coordination across internal organizations, design consultants, construction teams, operators, and external delivery partners.
Partner with Construction, Engineering, Operations, Network, Capacity Planning, Energy, Security, and other OCI organizations to ensure infrastructure requirements are coordinated and incorporated into project designs.
Provide senior-level oversight of architects, engineers, consultants, colocation providers, and other design partners responsible for delivering OCI infrastructure.
Establish expectations for consultant scope, performance, technical quality, schedule adherence, and design deliverables.
Ensure Basis of Design, SD, DD, permit, IFC, and record design packages meet OCI requirements and are appropriately reviewed and approved.
Drive standardization and repeatability while maintaining the flexibility necessary to address regional requirements, site conditions, utility constraints, code requirements, and evolving technology.
Evaluate proposed design changes and deviations to determine portfolio-level impacts to reliability, operations, schedule, cost, standards, and future scalability.
Develop and monitor design performance metrics, portfolio risks, technical issues, and organizational priorities, providing clear reporting and recommendations to executive leadership.
Support strategic planning for future data center capacity, emerging technologies, new infrastructure architectures, and evolving cloud and AI requirements.
Represent OCI Data Center Design Management in executive reviews, technical workshops, partner engagements, design reviews, and other internal and external forums.
Build a culture of technical rigor, accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and disciplined design governance across the organization.

Required Qualifications:

Professional licensure required as a Registered Architect (RA) or Professional Engineer (PE).
Accredited degree in Architecture, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Structural Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
12+ years of progressively responsible experience in data center, mission-critical, industrial, or large-scale infrastructure design and development.
Significant leadership experience managing design professionals, multidisciplinary technical teams, and external architecture and engineering organizations.
Demonstrated experience leading large-scale hyperscale, cloud, colocation, or mission-critical infrastructure programs.
Strong multidisciplinary understanding of data center architectural, structural, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, controls, life safety, and supporting infrastructure systems.
Demonstrated ability to establish and manage design governance, standards, technical requirements, and change control across multiple concurrent projects.
Experience managing complex project portfolios involving multiple sites, delivery partners, consultants, and internal stakeholders.
Strong understanding of data center mechanical and cooling infrastructure, with experience in high-density and liquid-cooled environments strongly preferred.
Strong understanding of data center electrical distribution, resiliency strategies, controls, commissioning, and operational requirements.
Demonstrated ability to identify, communicate, and resolve complex technical and organizational risks.
Experience working within accelerated design and construction programs where schedule, scalability, repeatability, and technical quality are critical.
Strong executive communication, organizational leadership, negotiation, and decision-making skills.
Ability to communicate complex technical issues clearly to both executive and technical audiences.
Working knowledge of applicable data center codes, standards, and industry guidance, including NFPA, ASHRAE, IBC, and other applicable international, national, and local requirements.

Preferred Qualifications:

15+ years of experience in mission-critical or large-scale infrastructure design and development.
Experience leading design organizations supporting hyperscale cloud or AI infrastructure.
Experience managing global or multi-region data center portfolios.
Experience developing and implementing enterprise-level data center design standards, specifications, and governance programs.
Experience with high-density compute environments, direct-to-chip liquid cooling, advanced thermal management, and next-generation data center infrastructure.
Experience with colocation and developer-led delivery models, including oversight of third-party design and construction partners.
Experience implementing formal design review, technical deviation, change management, and lessons-learned processes.
Working knowledge of BIM, digital design coordination, document management, and design collaboration platforms.

new_jobs.title: Senior Director, Data Center Facilities Development
new_jobs.description:
Job Description

The Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Data Center Development organization leads the planning, design, and delivery of the next generation of Oracle’s global data center portfolio. We are seeking a Senior Director of Data Center Development to provide strategic leadership and organizational oversight for the design of mission-critical infrastructure across OCI’s rapidly expanding global footprint.

This role is responsible for establishing and executing OCI’s data center design strategy across a portfolio of large-scale, highly complex developments. The Senior Director will lead a team of design management professionals and provide executive-level oversight of multidisciplinary design activities spanning architectural, structural, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, controls, and mission-critical infrastructure systems.

The position requires a combination of organizational leadership, technical depth, design governance, and portfolio management. The successful candidate will establish clear design requirements, drive consistency across projects and delivery partners, manage technical risk, and ensure that OCI’s facilities meet established requirements for performance, reliability, resiliency, scalability, constructability, and operational readiness.

The Senior Director will serve as a senior technical and organizational leader within OCI Data Center Development, partnering closely with Construction, Engineering, Operations, Network, Capacity Planning, Energy, Security, and other internal organizations. The role will also provide senior-level direction to colocation partners, architects, engineers, consultants, contractors, and other external stakeholders responsible for delivering OCI

Responsibilities

Responsibilities:

Lead the Data Center Design Management function for an assigned global or multi-region portfolio of hyperscale and mission-critical infrastructure projects.
Establish organizational priorities, expectations, governance processes, and performance standards for the design management team.
Lead, develop, and mentor design managers and design leadership personnel, establishing clear accountability for project execution, technical quality, and professional development.
Provide portfolio-level oversight of multidisciplinary data center design across architectural, structural, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, controls, life safety, and supporting infrastructure systems.
Establish and maintain design governance throughout the project lifecycle, from early planning and Basis of Design development through schematic design, design development, construction documentation, construction support, commissioning, and record documentation.
Ensure projects maintain alignment with OCI technical requirements, design standards, operational requirements, reliability objectives, and infrastructure strategies.
Provide senior technical leadership for high-density compute environments, including mechanical systems, liquid cooling, electrical infrastructure, controls, and other mission-critical systems supporting next-generation cloud and AI infrastructure.
Drive consistent implementation and continuous improvement of OCI global data center design standards, specifications, design criteria, and best practices.
Establish effective design review, technical approval, change management, and decision-making processes across the portfolio.
Identify systemic and project-specific design risks and ensure appropriate mitigation, escalation, and resolution before those risks impact construction, schedule, cost, reliability, or operations.
Lead resolution of complex multidisciplinary technical issues requiring coordination across internal organizations, design consultants, construction teams, operators, and external delivery partners.
Partner with Construction, Engineering, Operations, Network, Capacity Planning, Energy, Security, and other OCI organizations to ensure infrastructure requirements are coordinated and incorporated into project designs.
Provide senior-level oversight of architects, engineers, consultants, colocation providers, and other design partners responsible for delivering OCI infrastructure.
Establish expectations for consultant scope, performance, technical quality, schedule adherence, and design deliverables.
Ensure Basis of Design, SD, DD, permit, IFC, and record design packages meet OCI requirements and are appropriately reviewed and approved.
Drive standardization and repeatability while maintaining the flexibility necessary to address regional requirements, site conditions, utility constraints, code requirements, and evolving technology.
Evaluate proposed design changes and deviations to determine portfolio-level impacts to reliability, operations, schedule, cost, standards, and future scalability.
Develop and monitor design performance metrics, portfolio risks, technical issues, and organizational priorities, providing clear reporting and recommendations to executive leadership.
Support strategic planning for future data center capacity, emerging technologies, new infrastructure architectures, and evolving cloud and AI requirements.
Represent OCI Data Center Design Management in executive reviews, technical workshops, partner engagements, design reviews, and other internal and external forums.
Build a culture of technical rigor, accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and disciplined design governance across the organization.

Required Qualifications:

Professional licensure required as a Registered Architect (RA) or Professional Engineer (PE).
Accredited degree in Architecture, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Structural Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
12+ years of progressively responsible experience in data center, mission-critical, industrial, or large-scale infrastructure design and development.
Significant leadership experience managing design professionals, multidisciplinary technical teams, and external architecture and engineering organizations.
Demonstrated experience leading large-scale hyperscale, cloud, colocation, or mission-critical infrastructure programs.
Strong multidisciplinary understanding of data center architectural, structural, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, controls, life safety, and supporting infrastructure systems.
Demonstrated ability to establish and manage design governance, standards, technical requirements, and change control across multiple concurrent projects.
Experience managing complex project portfolios involving multiple sites, delivery partners, consultants, and internal stakeholders.
Strong understanding of data center mechanical and cooling infrastructure, with experience in high-density and liquid-cooled environments strongly preferred.
Strong understanding of data center electrical distribution, resiliency strategies, controls, commissioning, and operational requirements.
Demonstrated ability to identify, communicate, and resolve complex technical and organizational risks.
Experience working within accelerated design and construction programs where schedule, scalability, repeatability, and technical quality are critical.
Strong executive communication, organizational leadership, negotiation, and decision-making skills.
Ability to communicate complex technical issues clearly to both executive and technical audiences.
Working knowledge of applicable data center codes, standards, and industry guidance, including NFPA, ASHRAE, IBC, and other applicable international, national, and local requirements.

Preferred Qualifications:

15+ years of experience in mission-critical or large-scale infrastructure design and development.
Experience leading design organizations supporting hyperscale cloud or AI infrastructure.
Experience managing global or multi-region data center portfolios.
Experience developing and implementing enterprise-level data center design standards, specifications, and governance programs.
Experience with high-density compute environments, direct-to-chip liquid cooling, advanced thermal management, and next-generation data center infrastructure.
Experience with colocation and developer-led delivery models, including oversight of third-party design and construction partners.
Experience implementing formal design review, technical deviation, change management, and lessons-learned processes.
Working knowledge of BIM, digital design coordination, document management, and design collaboration platforms.
LEED AP, Uptime ATD, or other relevant mission-critical industry certifications.
Demonstrated experience developing high-performing technical teams and future organizational leaders.
